title: Mask/never log full cardholder data
text: Mask PAN when displayed and render it unreadable anywhere it is stored, including logs, debug output, and error messages. Full card numbers and CVV/CVC values must never appear in application logs.

title: Protect stored authentication credentials
text: Render stored authentication credentials (passwords, API keys, tokens) unreadable using strong cryptography. Credentials must never be hardcoded in source code or committed to version control.

title: Encrypt transmission of cardholder data across open, public networks
text: Use strong cryptography (TLS 1.2+) to safeguard cardholder data during transmission over open, public networks. Plaintext HTTP must never be used for payment-related traffic.

title: Address common coding vulnerabilities in software-development processes
text: Develop applications based on secure coding guidelines to prevent common vulnerabilities, including injection flaws, in software development processes.
